question: Who is the writer of Indian president's biography 'Droupadi Murmu : From Tribal Hinterlands to Raisina Hill' ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kasturi Ray**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kasturi Ray** is the writer of the Indian president's biography '**Droupadi Murmu: From Tribal Hinterlands to Raisina Hill**'.
 
• This biography covers the journey and life of **Droupadi Murmu**, who became the **15th President of India**.
 
• Droupadi Murmu hails from a **tribal background** in Odisha, and her rise to the presidency is a significant milestone.
 
• The book provides an in-depth look at her personal life, struggles, and achievements.
 
• Kasturi Ray is known for her **journalistic work** and has contributed to various publications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kamala Surayya**__

 __
 
• Kamala Surayya, also known as Kamala Das, was a renowned Indian poet and author.
 
• She wrote in both English and Malayalam and is known for her bold and honest portrayal of women's experiences.
 
• Her notable works include **“My Story”**, an autobiography, and several poetry collections.
 
 
 
• **Phoolan Devi**__
 __
 
• Phoolan Devi was an Indian bandit turned politician.
 
• She was known as the "Bandit Queen" and her life story was later made into a movie with the same title.
 
• She served as a Member of Parliament before her assassination in 2001.
 
 
 
• **Mary Kom**__
 
 
• Mary Kom is an Indian boxer and a six-time world champion.
 
• She is the only woman to have won a medal in each one of the seven world championships.
 
• Mary Kom has also won an Olympic bronze medal in the 2012 London Olympics.
